features.timePolicy: Sample equally spaced real frame positions from first to last voiced frame. Interpolate F0 at those positions; do not concatenate voiced frames across gaps.
features.weakVoicingPolicy: All-zero float32[68] and explicit PITCH_INSUFFICIENT_VOICING flag. A zero vector is unavailable evidence, never a wrong tone label.

cache.otherSplits: Keep metadata counts but never open test/diagnostic audio; explicit include-test is rejected.
cache.key: Original audio SHA256; identity binds model, license, adapter, audio decoder, pitch feature code, protocol and base manifest SHA256.
cache.predeclaredNumericalOrPlaceholder: Keep row with all-zero unavailable evidence and source flags; do not train from placeholder speech.
cache.labelPolicy: Pitch extraction never reads targets, expert correctness, transcript or phonetic labels. Downstream learning applies its separately frozen label policy.

limitations: No real F0 ground truth is available in these Mandarin calibration recordings.
Voicing, continuity and tracker disagreement do not establish F0 or tone accuracy.
Median F0 is included for compatibility with the existing68-dimensional branch; independent speaker-isolated validation is required.
This version needs separately trained heads; original YIN head weights cannot interpret it.
